verdict.rationale: Beamer is a SaaS product with an AI writing feature, so a buyer could fairly ask about an AI-training opt-out. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any training opt-out, data-use policy, or privacy control for AI models. The only AI mention is AI-assisted changelog writing, which says nothing about how customer data is used.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
